references.text: Moses gives instructions about war against the Midianites, where the Israelites take women and children captive, showing the same practice of taking prisoners of war.
Earlier laws on warfare in Deuteronomy describing how the Israelites were to treat cities they conquered and take the population captive.
Abraham goes to war to rescue Lot and takes back captives and property, illustrating early practices of warfare and captivity.
The Lord gives Ai and its king into Joshua's hand, with a promise of victory parallel to the promise that God will deliver enemies into the hands of the Israelites.
The Lord delivers enemies into the hands of the judges, showing the same pattern of divine help in war.
A promise that the Lord will deliver enemies to Israel, using the same wording about divine delivery of the enemy.
